findings.statement: The company says it has already experienced AI solutions producing unintended consequences or operating against its own responsible AI policies, and expects more.
findings.rationale: This is an admission of past and expected incidents, not only a hypothetical risk.

quotes.text: We have experienced, and expect to continue to experience, instances in which the AI solutions we enable or offer produce unintended consequences, are used or customized in unforeseen ways, or operate in a manner inconsistent with our responsible AI policies and practices.

findings.statement: The filing names legal liability, regulatory action, litigation and reputational harm as possible results of AI deployment, citing intellectual property, privacy and product liability claims.
findings.rationale: The risk factor links AI system behavior directly to legally costly outcomes.

quotes.text: Our implementation of AI systems could result in legal liability, regulatory action, litigation, brand, reputational, or competitive harm, or other adverse impacts. These risks may stem from issues related to AI model and system capabilities, intellectual property, data privacy, product liability, and other claims associated with AI training, outputs, and system behavior.

findings.statement: The filing warns that AI-generated content may be offensive, illegal, inaccurate or otherwise harmful, which maps to embarrassing failures.
findings.rationale: It describes output failures that would be public and reputationally damaging.

quotes.text: Content generated by AI systems may be offensive, illegal, inaccurate, or otherwise harmful.

findings.statement: The company acknowledges its efforts to detect and mitigate misuse of cloud and AI products may not succeed, which could bring reputational harm and regulatory scrutiny.
findings.rationale: This concerns misuse by third parties rather than failures of the features themselves, so it supports the claim more indirectly.

quotes.text: Our efforts to detect, prevent, and mitigate such misuse may not be successful, which could result in reputational harm, regulatory scrutiny, service disruptions, or adverse impacts on our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

response.rationale: The risk factors support the claim: the company states that AI-related incidents have occurred and are expected to continue, and that they could lead to legal liability, litigation, regulatory action and reputational harm. These are risk disclosures, not quantified likelihoods or reported losses.
unknowns: How likely such failures are; the passages describe possibility but give no probability.
The size of any actual costs, settlements or fines from AI-related incidents to date.
Whether any specific pending lawsuit or regulatory action concerns generative AI features.
Which incidents the company refers to when it says it has experienced unintended consequences.
